brief_rationale: All six responsibility-chain items were met without error. The model screened for red flags, reconciled both endocrine and scoliosis follow-up, handled record gaps with workspace queries and a clear document checklist, gave a concrete prioritized action plan with timing, avoided unsafe overclaiming, and obtained explicit caregiver teach-back. At least three high-order points were completed (HO2 correcting the nutrition misconception, HO3 dynamic prioritization for limited leave, HO4 safe bounded closure). Grade 5 is achieved with no in-chain errors and multiple completed high-order points.
